statement.zh: **人物**：约安·达门（Joan Daemen）。本行是人物行，其原理对应贡献而非算法叙述。书的扉页印出作者「Joan Daemen, Vincent Rijmen」与书名「The Design of Rijndael」「AES -- The Advanced Encryption Standard」；序言又印出「Rijndael was the surprise winner of the contest for the new Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) for the United States.」，并把胜出归给「its two Belgian designers, Joan Daemen and Vincent Rijmen」。因此该条目把达门定位为 Rijndael 的共同设计者，不把 AES 标准制定或 NIST 的组织工作归给他。
statement.en: **Person**: Joan Daemen.It is registered under symmetric block ciphers.

statement.zh: 设计原理由序言概括为 wide trail 策略，并印出其结果：「Excellent resistance to differential and linear cryptanalysis follow as a result.」。因此该条目只说 Rijndael 通过该策略获得对差分与线性密码分析的抵抗，不把这段评价扩写成对全部已知攻击的形式化证明。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in symmetric block ciphers, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 采用事实由 Rivest 的序言印出：「The adoption of Rijndael as the AES is a major milestone in the history of cryptography.」。该条目只转述这句序言并把采用限定为 Rijndael 成为 AES，不声称达门本人参与了标准制定，也不把后来的广泛部署归为他的个人行动。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 边界由书的章节安排印出：「Chapter 10 gives an overview of the published attacks on reduced-round variants of Rijndael.」。因此该条目只说书中综述的是对缩减轮数变体的已发表攻击，不称完整 Rijndael/AES 已被攻破，也不把缩减轮数结果读成对完整标准的实际威胁。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.
